Since 1995

Village Market’s salon, three decades in.

Salon Malibu has been part of Village Market since long before most of Gigiri’s newer names arrived — a first-class team of internationally trained and Kenya-based stylists working with Redken, Sebastian, Kérastase, L’Oréal Professionnel and Wella.

These days that's grown into a full aesthetics room too — HydraFacial, Guinot facials and the Alma Soprano Titanium laser sit alongside the chairs, so most of what a regular needs is under one roof.

“Debbie is absolutely the best — her cuts are precise, her colouring is amazing, and she really listens.”
